summary: Comprehensive E2E test of CaptionIQ Studio major upgrade features for proj_30bda645b428 (portrait 720×1280, 14 Whisper-transcribed words). All 13 review-request feature tests PASSED. No bugs found.

design_issues.screen: Caption overlay - template active word color
issues: When semanticHighlight is enabled, the active word always shows entity color (#FACC15 for person, #60A5FA for location) instead of the template-specific active color (e.g., News #FDE047 yellow, Hormozi inverted black-on-white). This means Hormozi 'inverted active word' and News 'yellow active' only appear for words without entity tags. This is by-design per the code, but visually the template-specific active styles are partially masked by semantic coloring. Low priority — design decision.

critical_code_review_comments: Studio.jsx is 1017 lines — exceeds 700 line limit. Consider splitting into smaller sub-components (e.g., StudioExportBar, StudioRenderDialog). Low priority refactor.
buildChunks uses maxWords:7 by default with maxGap:0.8 and maxDur:3.5 — this produces 7-word chunks for the 14-word project, creating clean 2-line splits. Working as intended.

Hormozi 'inverted active word' (black text on white bg) is masked by semanticHighlight entity coloring — entity words always use ENTITY_COLORS when active. This means the template-specific active style only applies to non-entity words. Acceptable design trade-off but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-existing test project proj_30bda645b428 (portrait 720×1280 video + 14-word Whisper transcript with entity tags).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Studio upgrade features from this iteration are working. Tested: multi-line captions, 16 templates, portrait/landscape detection, timeline word track entity coloring, word-seek click, RAF timing, Effects panel, Safe Area toggle, Export toolbar. The project proj_30bda645b428 has a portrait 720×1280 video (35s) with 14 words timed 0-5.6s. Video at time 0.9s=Mumbai active, 1.5s=today active. Template switching is instant (no re-generation). Semantic entity coloring overrides template active color (person→gold, location→blue, action→green, emotion→pink). Effects panel has Words/chunk slider (default 7) which controls 1 vs 2-line splits.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
